First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 6:00 pm. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: casual, no-drop. It's no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That's the point of a group ride.
Check
Look at @thewednesdayride the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the The Wednesday Ride group ride

A laid-back evening roll through downtown Colorado Springs. Casual pace, all skill levels, no one left behind. Runs March through October. Start point is posted on Instagram.
